svg.aria-label: Escea Fireplace for Home Assistant. Home Assistant integration. Escea gas fireplaces, both the Ethernet models and the newer Wi-Fi ones: on and off, temperature, Boost and Flame effect, the fire's own timers and its diagnostics. Built so it can never re-light a fire someone turned off.
